teamDeleteConfirmCopy: The team and linked participations will be removed. This cannot be undone.
teamOwnerCannotLeave: The owner cannot leave the team. Delete the team if needed.
toastTeamActionUnavailable: The team is no longer available.
diagnosticsConsoleConcatenateAria: Append to the last terminal line, or start one if the terminal is empty
objectsIntro: Objects attached to the selected Tile.
objectBoxMaterialRandom: Color is randomized at Play from the execution seed; the preview does not use noise.
objectVictimMaterialFixed: Material fixed by type: polished metal for live victims and muted black plastic for dead victims.
objectZulMaterialFixed: Fixed materials from the original Zul model; the object is anchored at its base.
objectOpacityFixed: Opacity is fixed at 100% for evacuation points.
objectResetDetail: Restores transforms and velocity on New Attempt when applicable.
objectBoxScaleFixed: Scale is controlled by the original Box profile; only position can be edited.
objectTransformAdvancedCopy: Use the manual fields only when you need precision beyond the buttons.
objectFieldNote: Available fields depend on the object type.
profileAppearanceDetail: Shown in the header and sessions.
profileEmojiCategoryHint: Faces filter the list; symbols below select an emoji.
profileAvatarSizeAria: Adjust the emoji or initials size
preferencesFpsDetail: Shows the frame rate during simulation.
preferencesArenaGridDetail: Shows a tile-sized grid while placing content.
preferencesCameraDetail: Adjusts orbit, pan and zoom in the space.
invertDragDetail: Inverts the orbit and pan direction for mouse and touch.
dragDirectionDetail: Default: mouse moves the camera; touch grabs the scene.
advancedControlsDetail: Shows an extra preparation step before starting.
sessionsIntro: These sessions can access your account. The current session cannot be ended here.
arenaInfoNoPath: This Arena does not use a scored path.
arenaInfoScoringDisabled: Scoring is disabled for this Arena.
arenaInfoScoreUnavailable: The path is not valid enough to calculate scoring yet.
settingsRandomTimeByDifficultyDetail: When on, time stays at 12:00 until Random resources set it from the selected difficulty.
settingsStopGameOnTimeLimitDetail: When on, the time limit ends the routine; when off, it remains a reference only.
settingsDebugWithoutProgram: Allow Play without a program in debug mode
settingsDebugWithoutProgramDetail: Allows starting without a program. With no program, Diagnostics enables manual movement and sensor readings; with a program selected, only Allow Diagnostics during routine grants this access.
settingsPathCompileDetail: Keeps path tracking and validation active.
settingsAdvanceDetail: Shows the Advance action during the routine.
settingsForceAdvanceDetail: Allows advancing automatically when the segment threshold is reached.
settingsEndGoalDetail: Finishes when the robot reaches the Tile marked as the arrival.
settingsPositionDetail: Shows component readings and the local physics profile; it also allows local Play without a program and manual repositioning during a routine.
settingsIncompleteTimeDetail: Uses the total limit even when the path is incomplete.
settingsLackProgressDetail: Detects sections without progress and applies the configured rule.
settingsRescueDetail: Keeps the kit within Arena rules.
settingsCheckpointNote: Set checkpoint spacing before the attempt.
settingsStartKitDetail: Offers a kit attached to the robot before the routine starts.
settingsReturnKitDetail: Keeps unrescued kits following the robot when an attempt resets.
settingsEvacuationOnePerType: Only one evacuation area per type
settingsEvacuationOnePerTypeDetail: Keeps one green and one red area; when several options exist, they never occupy the same space.
objectRandomPositionDetail: Keeps Y and randomizes X and Z between −5 and 5 inside the Tile.
objectEvacuationBonusNone: No bonus configured for this object.
settingsEndRescueDetail: Finishes when all eligible victims are resolved.
settingsIgnoreDead: Ignore dead victim if any living remains
settingsIgnoreDeadDetail: Keeps the victim rule open while a living victim remains.
settingsVictimMultiplierDetail: Applies the victim multiplier to the final score.
settingsRescuePenaltyToggle: Apply lack-of-progress penalty in rescue segment
settingsRescuePenaltyToggleDetail: Subtracts the configured multiplier when rescue progress stalls.
settingsScoringDetail: Tracking and logs remain available when off.
settingsScoreRoundingDetail: Applied to the cumulative total after the multiplier; 0.5 rounds to the nearest half point.
settingsMedalsDetail: Sets the levels used in the Arena.
settingsScoreNote: Each scoring rule keeps points, multiplier and attempts; neutral values start at 0 and ×1.
settingsConstraintsDetail: Each limit can be enabled separately; enabling it reveals its penalty below.
settingsMaxWeightDetail: Limits the robot's total allowed mass.
settingsMaxUltrasonicDetail: Limits the number of ultrasonic sensors.
settingsMaxColorDetail: Limits the number of color sensors.
settingsMaxTouchDetail: Limits the number of touch sensors.
scorePerAttemptDetail: Overrides the base values for configured attempts.
conversionIntro: Conversion creates a new revision after showing the result and warnings.
navigationDialogCopy: There is an unsaved change. Choose how to protect your work before continuing.
navigationImportDialogCopy: There is an unsaved change. Save or discard the content before choosing a file to import.
navigationRobotDialogCopy: This robot has unsaved changes. Choose how to protect your work before opening another robot or section.
arenaHandoffTitle: Load the current Arena in the editor?
arenaHandoffCopy: The Arena loaded in Simulation can be opened in the Arena Editor without changing the saved reference.
arenaHandoffGeneratedCopy: Choose whether to edit the generated result or the original model with random resources.
arenaSimulatorTransferTitle: Use the Arena Editor's Arena in Simulation?
arenaSimulatorTransferCopy: The Editor has {editorArena} ({source}) while Simulation has {simulatorArena}. Choose which version to use.
toastArenaDraftDiscarded: Draft discarded. The base version was restored.
arenaSaveChoiceTitle: How do you want to save the Arena?
arenaSaveChoiceCopy: Choose whether this revision updates your personal Arena or creates a new copy.
toastRobotCopySaved: Robot copy saved and opened in the Workshop.
reviewDebugCopy: Review-only controls; not part of the product.
toastDiscarded: Change discarded. The surface remains available.
toastRoutine: Routine panel opened. Progress and history are here.
toastStart: Routine started; controls remain in the routine panel.
toastRobotPhysicsLoading: Preparing the Robot models. The simulation will start when they are ready.
toastRobotPhysicsTimeout: The Robot models are still loading. Physics will start when they are ready.
toastRobotPhysicsUnavailable: The Robot physics could not be built. Check the parts or retry loading them.
toastRescueKitPhysicsUnavailable: Rescue Kit physics could not be prepared. Try loading it again or skip this step.
toastRobotPhysicsShapeMissing: Part {part} is missing its required collider shape ({shape}). Physics did not start.
toastRobotPhysicsAssetMissing: The 3D model for part {part} did not load. Physics did not start.
toastRobotPhysicsFrameError: The simulation hit a physics update error: {reason}
toastSelectAll: Select a robot, arena and program before starting.
toastSettings: Settings opened in the Arena popup.
toastProgramLoaded: Program loaded with this document's default language.
toastProgramCreated: Program created with the selected language.
toastProgramSimulation: Simulation opened with the current program selected.
toastBlock: Part chosen; click a valid face.
toastRobotPaintSelected: Color selected; click a part to apply it.
toastColor: Color applied to the part; the document now has a pending change.
toastRotationChanged: Part orientation changed; the document now has a pending change.
toastAnchorChanged: Part anchor changed; the document now has a pending change.
toastAnchorUnavailable: This part has only one valid anchor.
toastPartNameAccepted: Part name applied. Save the robot to persist it.
toastPartNameUnchanged: The part name is already applied.
toastPaintUnavailable: The palette is available only for paintable structural parts.
toastErase: Deletion preview confirmed; the document now has a pending change.
toastEraseBlocked: The Controller is the robot root and cannot be deleted.
toastTile: Tile selected in the Arena space.
toastPlace: Placement preview active; confirm in Arena space.
arenaPlacementNoSelection: Choose a Tile in the catalog before placing.
arenaPlacementOutOfBounds: The Tile footprint crosses the Arena's 100×100 boundary.
arenaPlacementOccupied: That position is already occupied by another Tile.
arenaPlacementDone: Tile placed; the catalog stays active for repeated placement.
arenaTileCopied: Tile copied to the clipboard. Place mode is active.
arenaTileClipboardTextSelected: The Tile was not copied: text is selected in the sidebar.
arenaTileCut: Tile cut to the clipboard. Place mode is active.
arenaTileClipboardCleared: Tile clipboard cleared. The standard catalog is restored.
arenaTileMoveSkipped: The Tile advanced to the next available slot.
arenaTileMoveBlocked: There is no available slot before the Arena boundary.
arenaClearCopy: All Tiles and objects will be removed from this Arena. Undo can restore the content.
arenaCleared: Arena cleared. Undo restores all Tiles and objects.
arenaTileRemoved: Tile removed. Undo restores the complete footprint.
arenaUndoUnavailable: There is no Arena change to undo.
arenaRedoUnavailable: There is no Arena change to redo.
arenaObjectDraftInvalid: Choose an object type before applying.
arenaObjectEmpty: This Tile has no objects yet.
toastEventJoin: Enrollment confirmed. Choose an open round whenever you are ready.
toastEventAck: The current attempt acknowledgement was updated.
toastEventLocked: Run started; Arena, seed and navigation are locked.
toastEventPreflight: Review the kit and markers, then press Play when ready.
toastEventRoundClosed: This round's execution window is closed.
toastEventWithdrawUnavailable: This competition's enrollment window has closed.
toastEventCanceled: Participation canceled. The report and replay remain available.
toastNoDocumentChange: There are no changes to save.
toastSessions: Other sessions were marked for ending.
toastArenaChanged: Arena change applied. Save the Arena to persist it.
toastDocumentReloaded: Server version reloaded; the local change was discarded.
toastDocumentCopySaved: Copy saved; the current document was updated.
toastRoutineLogsCopied: Round logs copied to the clipboard.
toastRoutineLogsCopyUnavailable: The round logs could not be copied.
toastArenaSeedCopyUnavailable: The Arena seed could not be copied.
toastEventHistoryLogCopied: The round log was copied to the clipboard.
toastEventHistoryLogCopyUnavailable: The round log could not be copied.
toastRoutineReplayExported: Replay exported as a local file.
toastRoutineReplayExportUnavailable: This browser could not export the replay.
toastTileSavedProfile: Tile saved to the profile. This action did not save the Arena.
